run.machine: Windows-11-10.0.26200-SP0; AMD64; 12 logical CPUs; 11.71 GiB RAM
run.measured_by: scripts.benchmark_sample; psutil process-tree RSS and output disk sampled every 1s; transport attempts and per-stage perf_counter

measurement_scope.timing: One measured cold local 10-ID run; not a 5000-ID full-range runtime. Wall excludes post-run validation.
measurement_scope.disk: Actual end-of-run logical output bytes; peak sampled every second and includes final output.
measurement_scope.ram: Process-tree RSS sampled every second; avg is the arithmetic mean of samples.
measurement_scope.cooldown: Zero inter-pass cooldown: one pass only. HTTP rate-limit and retry/backoff waits remain included in wall and stages.
measurement_scope.profiles: Source and reference profiles use complete exported Publications; Version distribution uses all discovered Publications.
measurement_scope.unit_note: Legacy *_mb fields use MiB (1024^2 bytes), matching the original measurement; seconds rounded to 2 decimals.
